svg.title: Fig. 4-2 Learner topology
svg.desc: The topology has one three-head Main learner and three independent one-head specialists, for four logical learners and six online Q functions plus target copies. Every specialist bundle targets the whole Main replay, while the C3 route remains conditional.
svg.text: Four logical learners · six online Q functions · independent target copies
F₃ Main route opens only after its observational-alias gate passes

text.tspan: All three Main heads learn the same bundle
